data.DebugDisplay: Founded in 1894, Manchester City are a professional English club currently playing in the English Premier Division. The Cityzens side of 2026 will not easily be forgotten at the club, winning the Carabao Cup whilst finishing as UEFA Champions League and English FA Cup runners-up.
